# mekomIL — Claude Code plugin

**Generated by `tools/build_bundles.py`. Do not edit by hand.**
`skill/SKILL.md` is the client source. The catalog comes from MCP.

Installs both halves in one command — the skill that decides which Israeli guide a
question needs, and the connector that fetches it:

```
/plugin marketplace add ilanvys/mekomil
/plugin install mekomil@mekomil
```

The connector points at `https://mekomil-mcp.vercel.app/api/mcp`. Catalog metadata is served by MCP; skill
content is fetched from the public skills-il repos. MIT.
